astranl.example_intent: Is a 1756-L85E controller from Allen-Bradley in stock anywhere right now, and from authorized sellers?
astranl.next_possible_action: verify_astranl with the astralock_event id; check_counterparty_nl before paying a seller; create_task when a physical step is needed in the Netherlands
astranl.proof_level: seller-reported structured data at observation time, digest sealed by AstraNL; not a quote
astranl.returns: summary with availability, stock, sellers, authorized sellers, lowest EUR price seen, lifecycle; exact offers; per-source status; sanctions screening; proof with digest, moment seal and AstraLock event
astranl.use_when: you need to know whether a specific machine, robot, PLC, drive, servo, gearbox, sensor or electronic part is really obtainable now, from whom, at roughly what price, with proof

annotations.title: Ground a component in live market reality

description: Ground a machine, robot or industrial automation component in live market reality with ONE read-only call. Give a manufacturer part number and optionally the maker. AstraNL queries its verified distributor connections (Nexar/Octopart, Mouser, element14/Farnell NL, OEMsecrets) in parallel, keeps only offers whose part number matches exactly after normalisation, screens maker and sellers against the EU consolidated sanctions list and the US Consolidated Screening List, and returns availability, stock seen, authorized sellers, lowest unit price seen in EUR, lifecycle values and per-source status. Every fresh answer carries a SHA-256 digest sealed with the AstraNL moment seal and an AstraLock event id you can check later with verify_astranl. Limits: distributor data is seller-reported at the observed time, not a quote and not a delivery promise; NOT_FOUND_IN_CHECKED_SOURCES means only these sources; answers are cached for 24 hours. Never orders, contacts or pays anyone.

manufacturer.description: optional maker name, e.g. Allen-Bradley; offers from other makers are then dropped

mpn.description: manufacturer part number, exactly as printed by the maker, e.g. 1756-L85E
